_about: The safe hub at game start (locked: diary/DECISIONS_HUB.md; rules core/hub_rules.gd, room game/hub_room.gd, online game/net_hub.gd). center: the hub's middle in the world (metres; far from the islands, the colosseum and Aurelind). Everything else is metres from that middle, x across the hall (50 m), z along it (30 m; the stage is at the back, -z). countdown: seconds before everyone is sent to the island (red from red_last). hold: seconds F is held on the stage to be ready. button_reach: how close to the pedestal a player must stand to press it. spawns: where players appear. stage: the checkerboard stage [x0, z0, x1, z1] and its height. painting: the Aurelind painting on the right wall. tables: the two card tables (no House Dealer). door: the trophy room's doorway in the left wall; trophy_room: its floor [x0, z0, x1, z1]; jukebox: by the trophies. Numbers are placeholders.
